content: Metazeng si Job
Duen etew he ed-ubpà diyà te tanà he Uz he iyan ngazan din si Job. Metazeng wey wazà igkesawey kandin. Edtahud sikandin te Megbevayà wey ebpeninguhà he kenà mekevaal te mezaat.
Duen din pitu he anak he menge maama wey tetelu he menge vahi.

Duen din 7,000 he menge kerehidu, 3,000 he menge kemilyu, 500 he paris he vaka, wey 500 he menge vehiyan he menge asnu. Ne zuen din daan mahabet he menge suluǥuen. Iyan sikandin pinekesepian te langun he menge etew ziyà te zapit te edsilaan te Israel.
Neleyaman duen te menge anak din he menge maama is ebpesemsembayè dan ebpengemuran diyà te menge valey zan ne ibpetelavuk dan sikan is tetelu he etevey zan.

Ne kada egkepasad is keemuran, ebpemuhat si Job para melumpiyuwi haazà is menge anak din. Edsayu sikandin ed-enew ne ebpemuhat sikandin te menge pemuhat he edtutungen he para te kada anak din su egkeisip din he kela ke nekesalà is menge anak din, ne kela ke nekekaǥi zan te mezaat mehitenged te Megbevayà. Ne iyan heini layun ebeeli ni Job.
Is Nehuna he Kegezami ki Job
Ne sevaha he andew, midtiǥum is menge velinsuǥuen diyà te etuvangan te Nengazen, ne midtampu kandan si Setanas.
Migkaǥi is Nengazen diyà te ki Setanas te, “Hendei ka ebpuun?” Ne midtavak ni Setanas is Nengazen te, “Midriǥuriǥu a ziyà te kelibutan.”

Migkaǥi is Nengazen diyà te kandin te, “Neseǥipè nu ve is suluǥuen ku he si Job? Wazà iring kandin diyà te kelibutan. Metazeng sikandin wey wazà igkesawey kandin. Midtahud e zin wey ebpeninguhà he kenà mekevaal te mezaat.”
Midtavak si Setanas te, “Iyan dà idtehuza zin kenikew su ǥeina te edtuvazan nu sikandin.
Idlikey nu te kezeetan sikandin wey is pemilya zin, ragkes en is langun he menge azen din. Edtuvazan nu is langun he ebeelan din, umbe mibmahabet is menge uyaǥen din diyà te tivuuk he tanà.
Piru kuwaa nu is langun he ziyà te kandin, ne siguradu edrewakan ke zin.”
Migkaǥi is Nengazen diyà te ki Setanas te, “Sigi, kuwaa nu is langun he ziyà te kandin, piru kenè nu sikandin menuwa.” Umbe migenat si Setanas puun te etuvangan te Nengazen.
Ne sevaha he andew, nengemuran is menge anak ni Job diyà te valey te kinekekayan he suled dan,
ne zuen nekeuma he sevaha he etew ziyà te ki Job he ke sikandin te, “Dutun te id-eradu zey is menge vaka nu, wey ebpemenabtab diyà te egkehunaan dey is menge asnu nu,
ne midtik-awan key surunga te menge Sabyanhen. Mibpen-uwit dan is menge uyaǥen nu, ne mibpenhimetayan dan is menge suluǥuen nu. Ne sebsevaha ku zà te nekepelaǥuy para te kedtudtul kenikew.”

Ne zutun te kemulu pa egkaǥi haazà is etew, ne nekeume en maan is sevaha pa he etew he ke sikandin te, “Midtibas te kilat is menge kerehidu nu wey is menge ebantey kayi, ne nemematey sikandan. Ne iyan e zà ebpeketudtul kenikew su iyan e zà wazà meragkes.”

Ne zutun te kemulu pa egkaǥi haazà is etew, ne nekeume en maan is sevaha pa he etew he ke sikandin te, “Midsurung key te tetelu he grupu te menge Kildiyanhen. Mibpenguwa zan is menge kemilyu nu, ne mibpenhimetayan dan is menge suluǥuen nu, ne iyan e zà nekepelaǥuy te kedtudtul kenikew.”
Ne zutun te kemulu pa egkaǥi haazà is etew, ne nekeume en maan is sevaha pa he etew he ke sikandin te, “Dutun te kebpengemuran te menge anak nu ziyà te valey te kinekekayan he suled dan,
neketik-ew mekeuma is mevandes he keramag he ebpuun diyà te disirtu, ne nerundus is tivuuk he valey. Nerundusan is menge anak nu he nemematey sikandan. Ne iyan e zà nekepelaǥuy te kedtudtul kenikew.”
Ne hein nezineg haazà ni Job, midhitindeg sikandin ne mibindas din is bisti zin tenged te kegkeseeng din. Ne impekiskisan din is ulu zin ne midlangkeb sikandin diyà te tanà te ked-azap te Nengazen.

Ke sikandin te, “In-anak a he wazè ku uwiten ne ebpatey a zaan he wazè ku uwiten. Is Nengazen is mibeǥey te langun he naangken ku, ne iyan daan sikandin migkuwa kayi. Ereg he edeliǥen is ngazan te Nengazen!”
Minsan pa te iyan haazà nehitavù, wazà mekesalà si Job, su wazè din besula is Megbevayà.
